title: Senior EV Field Service Engineer - UK
tags_raw: ev; service; inverter; solar; renewables; energy; uk
description: Your mission Welcome to your new opportunity with Sungrow! As an EV Field Service Engineer , you will play a crucial role in supporting our customers and ensuring the reliable operation of Sungrow EV charging solutions across the UK. You will be a trusted technical partner, delivering remote and on-site support while helping customers get the most from our products. This is an exciting opportunity to become one of our early EV engineering specialists in the UK. You will have significant scope for career growth, including the potential to help build and lead a local EV engineering team in the future. Please note that this role involves up to 60% travel , with approximately three days per week spent on customer sites. Your ResponsibilitiesCustomer Service Device Monitoring & Remote Diagnostics Proactively monitor commissioned EV chargers remotely to identify potential issues. Diagnose and resolve charger malfunctions, communication issues, and electrical, electronic, or control-system faults. Troubleshoot communication with local inverters, energy meters, onboard controllers, and customer SCADA systems. Clearly explain issues and resolutions to customers, building confidence in Sungrow products. Implement proactive actions—including remote reboots, configuration changes, and firmware updates—to maximise fleet availability and minimise downtime. Commissioning & Field Troubleshooting Align commissioning activities for new EV chargers with customer requirements. Provide clear remote guidance and support for commissioning tasks. Plan and coordinate on-site commissioning with installers, electricians, platform technicians, and other stakeholders. Integrate EV chargers into customer systems, including local grids, EMS controllers, OCPP backends, and shared-meter arrangements. Configure systems to ensure safe, reliable, and seamless operation. Lead on-site troubleshooting for complex technical issues and replace faulty components in compliance with electrical safety regulations. Specialised Tool Expertise Develop strong expertise in Sungrow monitoring and diagnostic tools. Use these tools to identify potential issues early and support proactive maintenance. Product Improvement & Data Management Quality Issue Reporting Identify and document recurring quality issues for Product, R&D, and Manufacturing teams. Contribute practical field insights that support continuous product improvement. Database Management Maintain accurate customer, service, and issue records in internal systems. Data Processing Enhancement Support improvements to internal data-processing methods and platforms to strengthen performance evaluation and fault detection. Your profile Hands-on experience in an electrotechnical or electrical engineering field, with strong practical troubleshooting and analytical skills. A genuine interest in green technology and EV charging infrastructure. Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking and experience using command-line tools to diagnose network issues. Experience with OCPP and Modbus-TCP communication protocols is highly desirable. Ability to interpret electrical single-line diagrams to diagnose system performance and faults. Technical proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or professional statistical-analysis software; Linux knowledge is a strong advantage. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to support non-technical customers in troubleshooting situations. English proficiency at B2 level or above is required. Additional European languages are advantageous. Must be based in the United Kingdom and able to travel extensively across the country, with occasional international travel for training or troubleshooting. Existing right to work in the UK is required; visa sponsorship or relocation may be considered for exceptional candidates. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Stora Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses. Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated. In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators. We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next. Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it. The Role This is a genuine people leadership role. You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing. Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves. This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision. You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora. Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like. Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed. Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond. Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead. Performance & Progression Own the engineering performance and progression approach. Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes. Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team. Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews. Hiring & Team Development Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team. Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar. Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience. Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs. Team Health Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation. Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics. Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows. Technical Context Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within. Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations. Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership. Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development. Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises. A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago. Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding. description: We are hiring a Portfolio Partner to own our client book. Our clients are the portfolio: every company raising on Pairs gets a dedicated partner who carries their raise week to week. title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description: Abstract Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting. Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception. As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting. These tasks interest you Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences. Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations. Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections. Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility. Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results. That makes you stand out You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field. You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch . You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry , or multi-view vision . Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial. Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level) . Knowledge of German is desirable but not required. Salary information Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.
